Global and Local Information Centrality

Source: R/centrality-batch57.R
centrality_gli.Rd

The global and local information (GLI) method (Yang et al. 2020) gives every node the mass \(Iks + DC\), its improved k-shell index plus its degree, and scores a node by its own share of the total mass and the mass around it: $$I_i = \exp\Bigl[\frac{Iks_i + DC_i}{\sum_l (Iks_l + DC_l)}\Bigr] \sum_{j:\,1 \le d_{ij} \le r} \frac{Iks_j + DC_j}{d_{ij}}.$$ The improved k-shell index is \(Iks = ks + nit\), the k-shell index plus the round of the k-shell decomposition in which the node is removed.

Usage

centrality_gli(x, ...)

Arguments

x

Network input accepted by centrality.

...

Further arguments to centrality. The measure uses gli_radius (the distance range \(r\), default 3).

Value

A named numeric vector with one score per node, in input node order.

Details

The measure is computed on the simple undirected skeleton of the network, so direction, weights, loops and parallel edges are ignored. Rounds are counted from one through the whole decomposition, and all nodes at or below the current degree leave in the same round, as in Table 1 of the source. gli_radius is 3 by default, the value of the source. The total mass is taken over all nodes, so adding a component changes every score. The source assumes no isolated node; here an isolated node is left out of the decomposition and scores 0. A gli_radius that is not a whole number of at least one raises a cograph_bad_parameter error. normalized = TRUE divides the scores by their maximum.

References

Yang, Y.-Z., Hu, M. and Huang, T.-Y. (2020). Influential nodes identification in complex networks based on global and local information. Chinese Physics B, 29(8), 088903. doi:10.1088/1674-1056/ab969f .

See also

centrality_gravity, centrality_iksd, centrality.

Examples

centrality_gli(regulation_net)
#>    Explore       Plan    Monitor      Adapt    Reflect    Discuss Synthesize 
#>   97.89294  104.48803  111.51593  103.37051   95.48225   98.44290   91.83054 
#>   Evaluate     Create      Share 
#>  100.09278  106.16431  100.89033
